data.name: Kristi
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Christos' meaning 'anointed one'. In Christian tradition, the name Kristi symbolizes faith, hope, and love in following the teachings of Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to strive towards a closer relationship with God.

in_hebrew.name: חריסטי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Christos' meaning 'anointed' or 'beloved'. In Hebrew, this name is translated as 'Charis' meaning 'grace' and 'Tov' meaning 'good'.

in_greek.name: Χριστή
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Christos', meaning 'anointed' or 'chosen one'. In the New Testament, the name 'Christos' is translated as 'Jesus'.

in_latin.name: Christiana
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Christianus', meaning 'follower of Christ'. In this case, the feminine form is 'Christiana'.

in_english.name: Christy
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Christos', meaning 'anointed' or 'beloved'. In English, it is commonly spelled as 'Christy'.

biblical_reference.note: The name 'Kristi' does not appear in the Bible, but it is derived from the biblical name 'Christos'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kristi is commonly used as a given name among Christians, signifying a strong connection to the Christian faith and heritage. It is also used to pay homage to Jesus Christ and to keep His teachings alive.
data.spiritual_significance: Kristi is a name deeply rooted in spirituality. It is a reminder that all Christians are followers of the anointed one, Jesus Christ, and are called to live spiritual lives. The name encourages its bearer to have strong faith, to live a life guided by hope, and to show love towards others as taught by Jesus.
